news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (1.7x net interest cover). news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹3.81 loss per share (vs ₹0.71 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹3.81 loss per share (down from ₹0.71 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹191.0m (down 5.9% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹57.1m (down ₹66.7m from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 88% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 182% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
